title: Cardinal Alessandrino to the nuncio in Spain, 1568-69 (ASV SdS Spagna 6/I, 6/II)

steps.what: Fetched DECODE records R93-R102 and their attached transcriptions and key files with the repository cookie.
Found Lasry's reconstructed polyphonic key on every record; no plaintext attached.
Tried to check Serrano 1914 for the letters in clear via web search and HathiTrust full-text search; HathiTrust returned 403.
Beam search choosing one of two letters per digit, zeros as nulls, Lasry's nomenclator as four-digit moves, scored by it-cinquecento.
All ten 1568 letters read end to end as fluent Italian, apart from final padding and unlisted nomenclator codes.
Applied the same key to R115 (Spagna 6/II/13, 1569, catalogue 254); it reads.
Lasry (21 Sept 2026) rates this above the cases without key recovery: transcription plus decoding under an ambiguous polyphonic key. Ranking difficulty raised from 2 to 3.

outcome.method_basis: George Lasry's 2020 reconstructed key was attached to every DECODE record R93-R102 and R115 before the attempt; it is polyphonic (each digit two letters, zero a null), so the text was chosen by a beam search scored with an Italian language model.
outcome.notes: Readings are machine output under a polyphonic key: each digit's letter is chosen by the language model, so isolated letters and unlisted nomenclator groups (shown as [NN.]) are uncertain; the sense is continuous throughout. Not checked against contemporary decifrati or Serrano.

prior.where: George Lasry's reconstructed key (24 Oct 2020) is attached to every record R93-R102 and R115; no plaintext was posted. Serrano, Correspondencia diplomatica (1914) prints Alessandrino's correspondence and may give some of these letters in clear; not checked (HathiTrust blocked).

human: Set the target; supplied nothing further. DECODE reached with a cookie already in the repository.
